generation_enablement: Harness explicitly enabled global LLM generation and rewrite; inherited provider/model configuration was disabled and empty. Effective model_configuration is the declared experiment configuration, not a claim about a running product service.
qualification: Five public questions on stream only, one process/run. Not the 30-question C1 baseline, UI/HTTP/network latency, planner qualification, independent human answer review, Live coexistence or a speedup comparison.

timing_semantics.elapsed_span_seconds: First entry to final resume/close. Generator spans can overlap downstream validation and token consumption; do not add to other stages.
timing_semantics.exclusive_active_seconds: Owner active time minus direct instrumented child active time; does not invent uninstrumented stage boundaries.
timing_semantics.inclusive_active_seconds: Actual owner execution, including instrumented child owners. For generators sum time inside next/send/throw/close; excludes time suspended in the consumer.
timing_semantics.seconds: Existing runner measurement: _ask wall time including answer stream delivery and final session/cache persistence; excludes pre-question semantic-cache clearing.
timing_semantics.stage_totals: Exclusive owner time summed by declared stage; inclusive values retained per owner and per call for nested inspection.
timing_semantics.ttft_seconds: Existing runner time to its first delivered token; that token can belong to a fallback template. It is not necessarily model prefill time.
unavailable: Provider prefill/decode/load splits are not exposed by this production stream owner. No guessed split.
Kernel model work may continue concurrently while client validates a yielded token.
Existing Ollama keep-alive pinger remains enabled, runs in another thread, and is not attributed to a question.
